about: Defect of 2026-11-10 (owner's walkthrough of the opportunity inbox): mail candidates were filed under a line by subject words (mailCandidateLine), so a department's Winter Ball and a mentor mixer reached the research line as offers, and every find carried one line only. Each case is a mail the triage marked as an opportunity and the reader's answer for it, written the way the model answers: it tags social gatherings with a research claim when the sender is the department (the adversarial habit seen live). Expected: the five low-value gatherings are kept for dedupe but never pushed; the founders' night is kept because the startup line's goal is meeting investors; the hackathon serves two lines; the info session serves research.
